camel_example: aliyun resourcemanager UpdateRole --region cn-hangzhou --NewAssumeRolePolicyDocument '{"Statement":[{"Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"RAM":"acs:ram::12345678901234****:root"}}],"Version":"1"}' --RoleName ECSAdmin --NewDescription 'ECS管理员' --NewMaxSessionDuration 3600
description_en: Updates the information about a Resource Access Management (RAM) role
kebab_example: aliyun resourcemanager update-role --role-name ECSAdmin --new-assume-role-policy-document '{"Statement":[{"Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"RAM":"acs:ram::12345678901234****:root"}}],"Version":"1"}' --new-max-session-duration 3600 --new-description 'ECS管理员' --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateRole

parameters.help_en:
The name of the RAM role.

The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
RAM角色名称。

长度为1~64个字符，可包含英文字母、数字、半角句号（.）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: role_name

parameters.help_en: The trust policy of the RAM role
parameters.name: new_assume_role_policy_document

parameters.help_en:
The maximum session time of the RAM role.

Valid values: 3600 to 43200. Unit: seconds. Default value: 3600.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is used
parameters.help_zh:
RAM角色最大会话时间。

取值范围：3600秒~43200秒。默认值：3600秒。

取值为空时将采用默认值
parameters.name: new_max_session_duration

parameters.help_en:
The description of the RAM role.

The description must be 1 to 1,024 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
RAM角色描述。

长度为1~1024个字符
parameters.name: new_description
